name: Folk Hero
oracle_text: Commander creatures you own have "Whenever you cast a spell that shares a creature type with this creature, draw a card. This ability triggers only once each turn."
blocked_sentences: Commander creatures you own have "Whenever you cast a spell that shares a creature type with this creature, draw a card. This ability triggers only once each turn."

needs.what: a spell_cast trigger filter key meaning 'the cast spell shares a creature type with this ability's source object' -- e.g. shares_a_type_with: "self" honoured by triggers.matches_card_filter, intersecting the spell's creature subtypes with the current creature subtypes of the permanent that has the (granted) triggered ability
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The rest is expressible: a grant_ability static with affects {types: [Creature], is_commander: true, owner: you} handing over a grantable spell_cast trigger with max_per_turn: 1 and a draw effect. But the trigger filter has no way to name the source. selectors.matches' shares_a_type_with reads a binding (no 'self' spelling) and is effect-side only; triggers.matches_card_filter supports only shares_a_type_with_commander, which unions the subtypes of ALL your commanders via commander_subtypes -- including the partner of a partner pair and non-creature subtypes such as Background (Folk Hero itself is usually a commander, so casting another Background would wrongly draw). That is a different, broader card, not 'this creature'.
